title: 13 October 2015: Paul McCartney live at Nationwide Arena, Columbus, Ohio
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Nationwide Arena in Columbus, Ohio, USA, on 13 October 2015.

It was the 87th show of the Out There Tour, which lasted for 91 dates between May 2013 and October 2015. This concert was seen by 15,107 fans.

Paul is playing @nationwidearena, Columbus tonight. Going to the show? Use the hashtag #OutThere to share your night pic.twitter.com/74JxGsquNh

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 13, 2015

During the show McCartney invited two fans, Craig and Elizabeth Cermak, onto the stage. McCartney signed Craig’s arm and Elizabeth’s back, and both fans had the signatures tattooed after the event.

@brianrayguitar Thank you for the BEST CONCERT EVER! I am still in complete shock from being called ON STAGE! OMG! pic.twitter.com/QVB6dPX2V6

— Elizabeth Cermak (@CermakElizabeth) October 14, 2015

View this post on Instagram

Thank you Columbus O-hi-hi-hi-o! #OutThere pic.twitter.com/rUSizNQlaj

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 14, 2015

Here’s the performance of The Beatles’ ‘One After 909’ from the show:

Rocking the pink! #OutThere pic.twitter.com/1RvdQL2Ol3

— Paul McCartney (@PaulMcCartney) October 14, 2015

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the Nationwide Arena on 8 November 2025 during the Got Back Tour.

Can't wait to see all of you #OutThere in #Columbus tonight! R>O>C>K> !!

— Brian Ray (@brianrayguitar) October 13, 2015
